acceptance: Independent factual checker accepts all source-backed fields and scope; one actual provider attempt is observed. Missing model/usage/cost remains unknown. One task establishes no population noninferiority or selection benefit.
controls: Offline checker rejects schema-valid wrong source, scope, verified count, boolean-for-integer and missing/unknown citations. These are judge conformance, not model robustness trials.
credential_handling: Path supplied at execution; secret contents never included in repository, profile, headers logs or receipts.
future_pairing: Require identical returned model and provider across baseline/candidate or invalidate the paired comparison. Router changes cannot be attributed to context selection.

input_token_cap.enforcement: post-response eligibility; tokenizer unknown before free-router selection

intended_interpretation: Reconcile a single public experimental claim without promoting scoped CUA evidence to a Hermes performance claim.
stop: One inference attempt; no retries, paid fallback, sampling or post-hoc prompt repair. A failure is retained.
